specific.instructions: Score 0.0 to 1.0: how specific is this document to the exact role, company, and problems named in it, versus a template that could be sent to any employer, and are all claims about the author concrete and sourced rather than self-praise?

role-specific throughout with every claim traceable to the profile

rules.reason: artifact is not specific enough to this role

notes.bar: PASS requires score >= 0.90. Planted-bad control (generic boilerplate) must score below the bar on this same rubric or the gate is theater.
